question: How long may a pseudonymous ICRA assessment, its free-text notes, its consent record and its organization context be kept, who may erase them, and must a respondent be able to withdraw an assessment that they started?
decision: Delete unclaimed assessment content, free text and linkage data after 30 days through a verified job; allow the respondent to withdraw via a single-use authenticated capability. Claimed content follows an organization-approved classification/retention schedule (provisional maximum 2 years absent legal hold). Keep only the minimum non-content consent/transaction evidence needed for audit separately, with a documented lawful retention period; do not falsely claim every consent record can be erased immediately.
originalProposedDecision: Unclaimed assessments, notes, consent and context are deleted after 30 days (matching capability expiry); claimed ones follow the org's retention, default 2 years. The respondent may withdraw and delete an assessment they started via its token. Platform staff may erase on request, audited.
